sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for respondent submits that tribunal has awarded appropriate amount under various heads.
Hence, no enhancement is required in the instant case.
4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

5. Perusal of impugned award reveals that Tribunal has awarded Rs.2,400/-
for attendant charges, Rs.50,544/- for medical expenses, Rs.9000/- for loss of income during treatment and Rs.5,000/- for conveyance etc. charges and Rs.25,000/- for pain and suffering.
6.
In view of above and dislocation of shoulder/ fracture of femur bone, appellant is entitled to Rs.40,000/- for pain and suffering.
Enhanced amount of Rs.15,000/- shall carry interest at the rate awarded by tribunal.
Other findings recorded by the tribunal shall remain intact.
7. Accordingly, appeal filed by the appellant is partly allowed to the extent indicated herein above.
